title: Counterspeech for Mitigating the Influence of Media Bias: Comparing Human and LLM-Generated Responses

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the relationship between politically biased news articles (categorized by slant such as Hyper-Partisan Left, Skews Right) and offensive reader comments, and evaluating the quality, diversity, and persuasiveness of LLM-generated counterspeech designed to mitigate this polarized discourse.
